jobs.description:
The Analytics, Investment Optimization and Marketing Enablement (AIM) team – a part of Global Commercial Services Marketing group within American Express – is the analytical engine that enables the Global Commercial Card & Non-Card business. The team enables profitable business growth through data, analytics, decision science and AI-powered capabilities, providing actionable insights and innovative solutions to drive business and marketing strategy.

This role, based out of Gurugram, will be a part of the AIM team and will focus on developing and applying advanced Data Science and Generative AI solutions across Global Commercial Services. The incumbent will work on high-impact business problems spanning customer acquisition, engagement, targeting and personalization, product and portfolio analytics, marketing measurement and analytical productivity.

The role will focus on applying Generative AI to business and analytical problems and translating opportunities into hands-on solutions and prototypes. The incumbent will apply Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, agentic AI and other emerging AI techniques alongside traditional Data Science and Machine Learning approaches.

The position is part of a highly collaborative environment, working with partners across AIM, GCS Marketing, Product, Capabilities, Technology and other teams at American Express.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

This entry-level position focuses on delivering first-line (Level 1) troubleshooting, managing technical incidents, and ensuring minimal downtime for end-user computing environments. You will handle requests through multi-channel platforms (such as phone, chat, or self-service portals) while maintaining high customer satisfaction and adhering to service level agreements (SLAs).

Key Responsibilities

• Incident Management: Log, track, and manage IT support tickets accurately from creation to resolution within defined SLA timelines.
• Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve basic issues related to hardware, software, Windows operating systems, peripheral devices (like printers), and connectivity.
• Access & Collaboration Support: Assist users with access-related services, password resets, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and collaboration tools like Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams.
• Issue Escalation: Coordinate and escalate complex technical problems or critical incidents to specialized internal IT teams or third-party vendors when necessary.
• Knowledge Documentation: Create, update, and maintain knowledge base (KB) articles and support documentation to enhance self-service adoption and accelerate future resolutions.
• Operational Shift Support: Deliver continuous support while working in a fast-paced, rotational shift environment across designated Cognizant office locations.
